sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Save the Kitten is a time-management game where you'll need to use your trampoline to help the kittens jump to their mother's basket. The gameplay is simple yet engaging, requiring you to time your jumps perfectly to ensure the kittens reach their destination safely. As you progress through the levels, the game introduces new obstacles, such as Angry Tom's attacks, which will make it more challenging to rescue the kittens. To overcome these obstacles, you'll need to think strategically, using your trampoline to deflect Angry Tom's attacks and create a safe path for the kittens.

One of the key features of Save the Kitten is its use of a trampoline as the primary gameplay mechanic. The trampoline allows you to jump, deflect, and manipulate the kittens to reach their destination. As you progress through the levels, you'll unlock new trampolines with different properties, such as increased jump height or wider range, allowing you to access previously inaccessible areas.

In addition to the trampoline, you'll also have the option to purchase new sneakers for your cat. These sneakers will provide a speed boost, allowing you to move faster and respond to the kittens' needs more quickly. While the sneakers are not essential to the gameplay, they do provide a nice bonus for experienced players looking to take their skills to the next level.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Save the Kitten are engaging, challenging, and require strategic thinking. With its simple yet addictive gameplay, this game is perfect for players of all ages and skill levels.
